I checked the junction positions and the annealing Tms against `oligotm`. I didn't run a simulated PCR.\n\n**The edit:** The output plasmid is the input with a 39-nt insertion between input positions 213 and 214. The inserted sequence is `agtagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaa`. It sits right after the `catatg` NdeI site and before the `agcaagggcgag…` start of the GFP coding sequence. Nothing else differs, so one pair is enough.\n\n**Design:** The pair follows the Q5 SDM format, with the primers back-to-back and not overlapping. The forward primer carries the whole insertion as a 5' tail. The reverse primer is fully annealing and points away from the insertion site. Amplifying around the plasmid gives a linear product that the kit's KLD (kinase, ligase, DpnI) step circularizes into the output plasmid.\n\n| Primer | Sequence (5'→3') | Annealing length | Tm (`oligotm`) |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| fwd | `agtagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaa` + `agcaagggcgaggagc` | 16 nt | 63.5 °C |\n| rev | `catatgtatatctccttcttaaagttaaacaaaattatttctag` | 44 nt | 63.2 °C |\n\nThe 39-nt tail of the forward primer is not counted in its Tm or length, as you specified. Both annealing lengths are within 15–45 nt, both Tms are within 58–72 °C, and the two Tms differ by about 0.3 °C.\n\nThe file lists the forward primer first:\n```\n>fwd\nagtagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaagcaagggcgaggagc\n>rev\ncatatgtatatctccttcttaaagttaaacaaaattatttctag\n```","time":{"start":1793305139998,"end":1793305139998}}}
